taker.description: Address of wallet filling (receiver of the NFT).

relayer.description: Address of wallet relaying the fill transaction (paying for the NFT).

onlyPath.description: If true, only the path will be returned.

forceRouter.description: If true, all fills will be executed through the router (where possible)

forwarderChannel.description: If passed, all fills will be executed through the trusted trusted forwarder (where possible)

currency.description: Currency to be used for purchases.

currencyChainId.description: The chain id of the purchase currency

allowInactiveOrderIds.description: If true, inactive orders will not be skipped over (only relevant when filling via a specific order id).

source.description: Filling source used for attribution. Example: `reservoir.market`

partial.description: If true, any off-chain or on-chain errors will be skipped.

skipBalanceCheck.description: If true, balance check will be skipped.

excludeEOA.description: Exclude orders that can only be filled by EOAs, to support filling with smart contracts. If marked `true`, blur will be excluded.

maxFeePerGas.description: Optional custom gas settings. Includes base fee & priority fee in this limit.

usePermit.description: When true, will use permit to avoid approvals.

swapProvider.description: Choose a specific swapping provider when buying in a different currency (defaults to `relay`)

conduitKey.description: Conduit key to use to fulfill the order

x2y2ApiKey.description: Optional X2Y2 API key used for filling.

openseaApiKey.description: Optional OpenSea API key used for filling. You don't need to pass your own key, but if you don't, you are more likely to be rate-limited.

blurAuth.description: Advanced use case to pass personal blurAuthToken; the API will generate one if left empty.

Model554.description:
List of fees (formatted as `feeRecipient:feeAmount`) to be taken when filling.
Unless overridden via the `currency` param, the currency used for any fees on top matches the buy-in currency detected by the backend.
Example: `0xF296178d553C8Ec21A2fBD2c5dDa8CA9ac905A00:1000000000000000`

fillType.description: Specify preferred fillType. `preferMint`: First, tries to mint a new NFT if available; otherwise, it purchases from the secondary market. `trade`: Always buys from the secondary market, regardless of price. `mint`: Always mints a new NFT.

preferredMintStage.description: Optionally specify a stage to mint

preferredOrderSource.description:
If there are multiple listings with equal best price, prefer this source over others.
NOTE: if you want to fill a listing that is not the best priced, you need to pass a specific order id or use `exactOrderSource`.
